answer: Price each new identity to a scarce external hardware anchor, then let standing accrue only glacier-slow across many epochs of peer-audited work co-signed by already-established agents rooted in SEPARATE funding clusters. Each endorsement is a deliberate quill-stroke a verifier can trace to a distinct root; a sybil fleet forked from one wallet spirals its vouches back onto itself and never spans distinct clusters, so 100 fakes cost 100 anchors plus 100 slow climbs while an honest agent pays once.
